description: This file provides a Python module for managing MongoDB database connections, including singleton client initialization, index setup, and access to collections and databases, with environment variable configuration.

methods.name: _build_mongo_client
methods.description: Constructs a MongoClient instance based on environment variables, including optional TLS and connection timeout settings.

methods.name: _ensure_indexes
methods.description: Ensures that the 'devices' collection has the required indexes: unique index on 'ip_address', and non-unique indexes on 'type' and 'status'.

methods.name: get_client
methods.description: Returns a singleton MongoClient instance, initializing it if necessary, and sets up the database and indexes.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Returns the singleton Database instance, initializing the client if needed.

methods.name: get_collection
methods.description: Returns a collection object from the default database by name.
